global_codebook_application: This revision exports existing evidence and defines prospective recoding rules. It does not certify new exhaustive reading of all 5096 positions.
hierarchy: Keep source-scoped observation, cumulative effective state and examination coverage as three distinct fields. Preserve raw assessor disagreement; technical proof dispositions are separately labelled.

rules.category: Information not presented in examined source scope
rules.exclude: Unexamined source; no term hit; no code; protocol planning only.
rules.interpretation: Limited to that source or documented examined union; does not prove non-collection.
rules.positive_rule: An examiner explicitly records missing_after_examination for numerator or another required dimension and provides the relevant source/section.

rules.category: Reported population or original-arm set incompatible
rules.exclude: A numerical denominator difference alone without an established reason.
rules.interpretation: The source can report useful data while failing the fixed audit reference.
rules.positive_rule: An explicit incompatible subpopulation/denominator code or verified original table shows ITT versus treated, pooled trials or omission of an eligible original arm.

rules.exclude: Missing dates alone: classify the window as not established, not proven incompatible.
rules.interpretation: Source-specific reconstruction may remain possible; target reconstruction needs matching bounds.
rules.positive_rule: Source-defined follow-up is explicitly shorter, longer, on-treatment only or otherwise fails the target; distinguish planned observation from passive later notification.

rules.category: Counting unit or component not separable
rules.exclude: Do not infer suicide attempt from any C-SSRS behavior or death from unspecified trauma.
rules.interpretation: Preserve numerator meaning and modality, even with the same source.
rules.positive_rule: Examined table reports events, persons, composite suicidality/self-harm or an unseparated structured category incompatible with the required component/person count.

rules.category: Pertinent source not obtained or not examined
rules.exclude: An available file hash alone is not reading evidence.
rules.interpretation: Unknown effective reconstruction, unless a separate compatible positive witness is sufficient.
rules.positive_rule: Named source/inventory gap or explicit unknown dimension and incomplete scope is retained.

rules.exclude: A vote of complete without required source facts; pooled positive transport; guessed zero.
rules.interpretation: Overrides other unresolved sources only for the exact reference; underlying gaps remain recorded.
rules.positive_rule: Verified counts, treated arm denominators, counting unit, population and planned window for every eligible arm; derivation explicit if needed.
